narrative.documentConcept: Other zero or near-zero fee perp DEXs
narrative.text: Perp DEXs other than Lighter and Paradex that advertise zero or near-zero fees: Aster, Extended, edgeX, GRVT, Pacifica and Variational Omni. Read closely, most are zero on the maker side only. Extended and Aster charge 2.5 and 4 bps taker, edgeX and Pacifica 4-4.5 bps at base tier, GRVT pays a tiny maker rebate and charges 4.5 bps taker, and only Variational charges no explicit fee (it prices via spread). API access is mature at Aster, Extended, edgeX and GRVT, but Variational's public API is read-only with trading API still unreleased as of mid-November. Zero-fee status is incentive-dependent and has been revised upward elsewhere.
